48: public class ResultLevelCachingQueryRunner<T> implements QueryRunner<T>
49: {
50:   private static final Logger log = new Logger(ResultLevelCachingQueryRunner.class);
51:   private final QueryRunner baseRunner;
52:   private ObjectMapper objectMapper;
53:   private final Cache cache;
54:   private final CacheConfig cacheConfig;
55:   private final boolean useResultCache;
56:   private final boolean populateResultCache;
57:   private Query<T> query;
58:   private final CacheStrategy<T, Object, Query<T>> strategy;
59: 
60: 
61:   public ResultLevelCachingQueryRunner(
62:       QueryRunner baseRunner,
63:       QueryToolChest queryToolChest,
64:       Query<T> query,
65:       ObjectMapper objectMapper,
66:       Cache cache,
67:       CacheConfig cacheConfig
68:   )
69:   {
70:     this.baseRunner = baseRunner;
71:     this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
72:     this.cache = cache;
73:     this.cacheConfig = cacheConfig;
74:     this.query = query;
75:     this.strategy = queryToolChest.getCacheStrategy(query);
76:     this.populateResultCache = CacheUtil.isPopulateResultCache(
77:         query,
78:         strategy,
79:         cacheConfig,
80:         CacheUtil.ServerType.BROKER
81:     );
82:     this.useResultCache = CacheUtil.isUseResultCache(query, strategy, cacheConfig, CacheUtil.ServerType.BROKER);
83:   }
84: 
85:   @Override
86:   public Sequence<T> run(QueryPlus queryPlus, ResponseContext responseContext)
87:   {
88:     if (useResultCache || populateResultCache) {
89: 
90:       final String cacheKeyStr = StringUtils.fromUtf8(strategy.computeResultLevelCacheKey(query));
91:       final byte[] cachedResultSet = fetchResultsFromResultLevelCache(cacheKeyStr);
92:       String existingResultSetId = extractEtagFromResults(cachedResultSet);
93: 
94:       existingResultSetId = existingResultSetId == null ? "" : existingResultSetId;
95:       query = query.withOverriddenContext(
96:           ImmutableMap.of(QueryResource.HEADER_IF_NONE_MATCH, existingResultSetId));
97: 
98:       Sequence<T> resultFromClient = baseRunner.run(
99:           QueryPlus.wrap(query),
100:           responseContext
101:       );
102:       String newResultSetId = responseContext.getEntityTag();
103: 
104:       if (useResultCache && newResultSetId != null && newResultSetId.equals(existingResultSetId)) {
105:         log.debug("Return cached result set as there is no change in identifiers for query %s ", query.getId());
106:         return deserializeResults(cachedResultSet, strategy, existingResultSetId);
107:       } else {
108:         @Nullable
109:         ResultLevelCachePopulator resultLevelCachePopulator = createResultLevelCachePopulator(
110:             cacheKeyStr,
111:             newResultSetId
112:         );
113:         if (resultLevelCachePopulator == null) {
114:           return resultFromClient;
115:         }
116:         final Function<T, Object> cacheFn = strategy.prepareForCache(true);
117: 
118:         return Sequences.wrap(
119:             Sequences.map(
120:                 resultFromClient,
121:                 new Function<T, T>()
122:                 {
123:                   @Override
124:                   public T apply(T input)
125:                   {
126:                     if (resultLevelCachePopulator.isShouldPopulate()) {
127:                       resultLevelCachePopulator.cacheResultEntry(input, cacheFn);
128:                     }
129:                     return input;
130:                   }
131:                 }
132:             ),
133:             new SequenceWrapper()
134:             {
135:               @Override
136:               public void after(boolean isDone, Throwable thrown)
137:               {
138:                 Preconditions.checkNotNull(
139:                     resultLevelCachePopulator,
140:                     "ResultLevelCachePopulator cannot be null during cache population"
141:                 );
142:                 if (thrown != null) {
143:                   log.error(
144:                       thrown,
145:                       "Error while preparing for result level caching for query %s with error %s ",
146:                       query.getId(),
147:                       thrown.getMessage()
148:                   );
149:                 } else if (resultLevelCachePopulator.isShouldPopulate()) {
150:                   // The resultset identifier and its length is cached along with the resultset
151:                   resultLevelCachePopulator.populateResults();
152:                   log.debug("Cache population complete for query %s", query.getId());
153:                 }
154:                 resultLevelCachePopulator.stopPopulating();
155:               }
156:             }
157:         );
158:       }
159:     } else {
160:       return baseRunner.run(
161:           queryPlus,
162:           responseContext
163:       );
164:     }
165:   }
166: 
167:   @Nullable
168:   private byte[] fetchResultsFromResultLevelCache(
169:       final String queryCacheKey
170:   )
171:   {
172:     if (useResultCache && queryCacheKey != null) {
173:       return cache.get(CacheUtil.computeResultLevelCacheKey(queryCacheKey));
174:     }
175:     return null;
176:   }
177: 
178:   private String extractEtagFromResults(
179:       final byte[] cachedResult
180:   )
181:   {
182:     if (cachedResult == null) {
183:       return null;
184:     }
185:     log.debug("Fetching result level cache identifier for query: %s", query.getId());
186:     int etagLength = ByteBuffer.wrap(cachedResult, 0, Integer.BYTES).getInt();
187:     return StringUtils.fromUtf8(Arrays.copyOfRange(cachedResult, Integer.BYTES, etagLength + Integer.BYTES));
188:   }
189: 
190:   private Sequence<T> deserializeResults(final byte[] cachedResult, CacheStrategy strategy, String resultSetId)
191:   {
192:     if (cachedResult == null) {
193:       log.error("Cached result set is null");
194:     }
195:     final Function<Object, T> pullFromCacheFunction = strategy.pullFromCache(true);
196:     final TypeReference<T> cacheObjectClazz = strategy.getCacheObjectClazz();
197:     //Skip the resultsetID and its length bytes
198:     Sequence<T> cachedSequence = Sequences.simple(() -> {
199:       try {
200:         int resultOffset = Integer.BYTES + resultSetId.length();
201:         return objectMapper.readValues(
202:             objectMapper.getFactory().createParser(
203:                 cachedResult,
204:                 resultOffset,
205:                 cachedResult.length - resultOffset
206:             ),
207:             cacheObjectClazz
208:         );
209:       }
210:       catch (IOException e) {
211:         throw new RE(e, "Failed to retrieve results from cache for query ID [%s]", query.getId());
212:       }
213:     });
214: 
215:     return Sequences.map(cachedSequence, pullFromCacheFunction);
216:   }
217: 
218:   private ResultLevelCachePopulator createResultLevelCachePopulator(
219:       String cacheKeyStr,
220:       String resultSetId
221:   )
222:   {
223:     if (resultSetId != null && populateResultCache) {
224:       ResultLevelCachePopulator resultLevelCachePopulator = new ResultLevelCachePopulator(
225:           cache,
226:           objectMapper,
227:           CacheUtil.computeResultLevelCacheKey(cacheKeyStr),
228:           cacheConfig,
229:           true
230:       );
231:       try {
232:         //   Save the resultSetId and its length
233:         resultLevelCachePopulator.cacheObjectStream.write(ByteBuffer.allocate(Integer.BYTES)
234:                                                                     .putInt(resultSetId.length())
235:                                                                     .array());
236:         resultLevelCachePopulator.cacheObjectStream.write(StringUtils.toUtf8(resultSetId));
237:       }
238:       catch (IOException ioe) {
239:         log.error(ioe, "Failed to write cached values for query %s", query.getId());
240:         return null;
241:       }
242:       return resultLevelCachePopulator;
243:     } else {
244:       return null;
245:     }
246:   }
247: 
248:   private class ResultLevelCachePopulator
249:   {
250:     private final Cache cache;
251:     private final ObjectMapper mapper;
252:     private final SerializerProvider serialiers;
253:     private final Cache.NamedKey key;
254:     private final CacheConfig cacheConfig;
255:     @Nullable
256:     private ByteArrayOutputStream cacheObjectStream;
257: 
258:     private ResultLevelCachePopulator(
259:         Cache cache,
260:         ObjectMapper mapper,
261:         Cache.NamedKey key,
262:         CacheConfig cacheConfig,
263:         boolean shouldPopulate
264:     )
265:     {
266:       this.cache = cache;
267:       this.mapper = mapper;
268:       this.serialiers = mapper.getSerializerProviderInstance();
269:       this.key = key;
270:       this.cacheConfig = cacheConfig;
271:       this.cacheObjectStream = shouldPopulate ? new ByteArrayOutputStream() : null;
272:     }
273: 
274:     boolean isShouldPopulate()
275:     {
276:       return cacheObjectStream != null;
277:     }
278: 
279:     void stopPopulating()
280:     {
281:       cacheObjectStream = null;
282:     }
283: 
284:     private void cacheResultEntry(
285:         T resultEntry,
286:         Function<T, Object> cacheFn
287:     )
288:     {
289:       Preconditions.checkNotNull(cacheObjectStream, "cacheObjectStream");
290:       int cacheLimit = cacheConfig.getResultLevelCacheLimit();
291:       try (JsonGenerator gen = mapper.getFactory().createGenerator(cacheObjectStream)) {
292:         JacksonUtils.writeObjectUsingSerializerProvider(gen, serialiers, cacheFn.apply(resultEntry));
293:         if (cacheLimit > 0 && cacheObjectStream.size() > cacheLimit) {
294:           stopPopulating();
295:         }
296:       }
297:       catch (IOException ex) {
298:         log.error(ex, "Failed to retrieve entry to be cached. Result Level caching will not be performed!");
299:         stopPopulating();
300:       }
301:     }
302: 
303:     public void populateResults()
304:     {
305:       CacheUtil.populateResultCache(
306:           cache,
307:           key,
308:           Preconditions.checkNotNull(cacheObjectStream, "cacheObjectStream").toByteArray()
309:       );
310:     }
311:   }
312: }

part.text:
Fixed the result-level cache restore bug in `GroupByQueryQueryToolChest.java:647`.

The post-aggregator read loop wrote every cached post-aggregate into the same slot because `postPos` was never incremented. Adding `postPos++` ensures each post-aggregate is restored to its correct position.

Validation: `GroupByQueryQueryToolChestTest` passes all 20 tests, including the multiple post-aggregate cache case.
